name: Customer 360 Full CRUD & Activity Timeline
description: Verify customer accounts directory, Customer 360 overview, stats, company info, and activity timeline

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login, sign in as admin@flowcrm.local with password 'FlowAdmin123!', and navigate to /customers
Verify Customer accounts table displays company name, industry, phone, email, and owner
Click the first customer in the table to open Customer 360 details view (/customers/:id)
Assert Customer 360 view displays stats: Open Opportunities, Pending Tasks, Total Deals, and Last Activity
Assert Company Information panel renders company name, industry, email, and address
Assert Open Opportunities and Timeline panels are displayed
